title: TikTok Watermark Remover for Authorized Image Frames
description: Use this TikTok watermark remover on a still frame or image you own or have permission to edit. The current tool does not download or process videos.
heading: TikTok Watermark Remover for Permitted Image Frames
intro: Prepare a still frame from your own TikTok content or another asset you are authorized to edit. WatermarkGemini accepts supported images only; it does not download TikTok links, process full videos, or remove audio metadata.

process.heading: How to Use the TikTok Watermark Remover
process.intro: Start with your own permitted frame rather than a third-party video URL.

steps.title: Export Your Frame
steps.description: Save a frame from content you own or may edit as JPG, PNG, or WEBP.

steps.title: Upload the Image
steps.description: Upload one image up to 10 MB, sign in with Google, and start processing.

steps.title: Review Before Reuse
steps.description: Inspect the returned image and confirm you still meet the source platform, attribution, and rights requirements.

faq.heading: Questions About the TikTok Watermark Remover
faq.intro: Understand URL, video, rights, and image-format limits.

items.question: Can I paste a TikTok URL?
items.answer: No. The tool does not download from TikTok. Upload a supported still image that you already own or have permission to edit.

items.question: Can I upload MP4 or MOV video?
items.answer: No. The current uploader accepts one JPG, PNG, or WEBP image up to 10 MB.

items.question: Is WatermarkGemini affiliated with TikTok?
items.answer: No. WatermarkGemini is an independent image-cleanup tool and is not affiliated with or endorsed by TikTok or ByteDance.

items.question: May I remove a watermark from another creator's frame?
items.answer: Not without permission. Only edit content you own or are authorized to modify, and preserve required attribution and disclosures.
